explanation: Use the egg-dropping recurrence: a drop covers the floors below if an item breaks, the floors above if it survives, and the tested floor itself. A function-level cache retains solved (cases,drops) pairs across calls.
timeComplexity: O(S) newly computed states; O(c·d) for a fresh c-case/d-drop query
spaceComplexity: O(S_total) retained cache across calls, plus O(d) recursion
